items.name: Alpha Course | Discipleship Group
items.desc:
Are you exploring Christianity, new to the faith, or have never really examined why you believe what you believe? Alpha Course is a 10-week video series that provides a firm foundation for the faith. Subjects include: "Who is Jesus? Why did Jesus die? How can I have faith and know for sure I am going to Heaven? Why and how do I pray? How does God guide us?". After a thought provoking video, you'll have the opportunity to ask any questions in a judgement free atmosphere. No question is off the table! Purchase a meal from the coffee bar at 6:15PM and experience not only knowledge, but connection with other people on a similar journey.
This group starts October 7 at 6:30PM in the Conference Room. Park in the back of the building and enter through the Office Entrance.

items.name: Bacon + Jacobson | Home Group
items.desc:
The Jacobson's and Bacon's have been married for a combined 60 years. Both couples have military backgrounds.
We love God's gift of community and we want to show the love of Christ to you! If you are looking for a community group, we would love to get to know you as we share life together, worship together, grow together, encourage one another and carry one another's burdens, fulfilling the law of Christ (Galatians 6:2).
We look forward to studying God's Word with you, praying for one another, and growing in our faith as a community. Our group meets on Tuesday evenings at 6: and Old Ranch Road. We begin with some fellowship time followed by a discussion of the sermon and a time of prayer.

items.name: Brooks | Home Group
items.desc:
Learn more about our group here: https://your.nextstep.is/brooks-connect-group We meet on the east side of town near Constitution and Petersen. The Brooks believe true Christian community can't happen for 15 minutes in the lobby on Sundays. Small home groups are where Christ-followers can walk out their salvation genuinely with other believers. Tez and Christine first met as members of a small home group and married in 2002. Tez and Christine share the gospel as full-time missionaries and have lived in or visited more than 30 countries serving with Cru and the Jesus Film Project. They were based in Orlando until moving here in 2017.  The Brooks also serve in other ministries of Springs Church. They have four grown children.
*Please contact for address. tbrooks@springs.church .

items.name: Grief Share | Support Group
items.desc: A support group to help you move through the grief process. A GriefShare support group is a safe, welcoming place where people understand the difficult emotions of grief. Through this 13-week group, you'll discover what to expect in the days ahead and what's "normal" in grief. Since there are no neat, orderly stages of grief, you'll learn helpful ways of coping with grief, in all its unpredictability—and gain solid support each step of the way.

items.name: Haupt | Home Group
items.desc: Faith leads this group. Al and Faith have been a part of The Springs Church family for years. Al is retired from Lockheed Martin and Faith has a non-profit that gives her opportunity to teach and encourage in many parts of the world. By following Holy Spirit's lead, we want to go deeper and higher in our spiritual walk with the Lover of our souls. As we do that, we will grow closer to each other too! Let's do Acts 2 together!

items.name: Luke | Home Group
items.desc: Michael and Heather Luke, between the two, have been in Colorado for over 40+ years and together have 9 children and 15 grandchildren. Mike retired from the Air Force in 2004 and retired from federal service in 2025. Mike is currently owner/president of Luke Strategies LLC, a consulting business. Heather is a Family Nurse Practitioner here in the Springs and volunteers her time at the local Dream Centers women's clinic. Both enjoy being involved in connect groups and opportunities within the church to better live the life God has called them to live. When time allows, they are biking, hiking, baby-sitting, golfing, and exploring the beautiful Western United States.

items.name: Sherrill + Yuen | Home Group
items.desc:
Being in Christian community is so important and we love to spend time with people, getting to know their stories and growing in our faith together. As a community group we value the opportunity to share in God's word together and pray for each other. Our group meets in the Northgate / Fox Run area. We share a meal together and then meet to discuss the sermon and pray for one another.
* Please call for location. We alternate between our two houses.

items.name: Silver Warriors (Ages 55+) | Seniors Group
items.desc: We seek to provide opportunities to learn from one another, to serve one another, to encourage one another, and to pray for one another. There is no set format but we will allow the Holy Spirit to guide and direct us each week. The primary meeting will be every Tuesday, but we expect to see smaller groups choose to meet over a meal, take an easy hike, or undertake a service project at different times and places.

items.name: Stoddard | Home Group
items.desc: Zane and Jan have been a part of Springs Church since its beginning. We have lived in India and Thailand for 13 years and have a heart for the nations. We have been a blended family for 29 years and are marriage mentors and are on the missions committee. We enjoy hiking, cooking together, Zane likes fishing and working on projects. Jan likes crocheting and knitting. We want to see singles and couples grow in their faith and love for Jesus. We meet on Thursday evenings at 6:30pm, except for the 3rd Thursday of each month.

items.name: Taylor | Home Group
items.desc:
John and Peggy Taylor are Colorado Natives, Peggy was born in Denver and John in Pueblo. They met in college at USC and have been married for 48 years. They have three grown children also living in Colorado. They have two beautiful grandchildren, and one large golden doodle.

Peggy retired from the Colorado Deaf and Blind School. John retired from the City of Colorado Springs and the Harrison School District.

In their walk with Jesus they have led and attended a number of Christian fellowships. Peggy presently volunteers with the accounting department at the Springs Church. John assists with the Mentor program and with the Security Team at the Church. They both have the desire to see Christians grow in the Lord and in their friendships toward each other.

items.name: Broadmoor Waltz Lessons | Co-Ed Activity Group
items.desc: Looking to brush up your dancing skills? In sixteen weeks, learn how to pattern waltz for fun and for free. Couples will learn twelve choreographed waltz dances used by The Broadmoor Waltz Club.

items.name: Springs Friends | Special Needs Group
items.desc: Springs Friends meets each Sunday during the 10AM service near the coffee bar before joining the congregation for a time of worship. The ministry is developed for adults with intellectual or developmental disabilities in our church community. The group will join the congregation during the 10AM service for worship then move to the Conference Room for a time of biblical teaching, meeting the ministry participants at their level of understanding with a faith based curriculum for individuals with intellectual disabilities.

items.name: The Vine | Young Married Group
items.desc: We believe Christ has designed the marriage covenant to reflect his relationship to the Church. While the experiences of marriage are joyful for us, marriage is for the glory of God. Therefore, the vision of the Vine is to build Christ-centered marriages and young families by focusing on our GPS. G - GROW in faith through fellowship with other Christian families. P - Learn to PRAY and study God's Word as a family. S - Find somewhere to SERVE at Springs Church. Marriage and parenting can be challenging. Come and be refreshed with a potluck fellowship, games, and biblical discussions. We meet on the 2nd and 4th Thursdays of the month in the Kids Auditorium.

items.name: Buster | Men's Group
items.desc:
Jimmie and his family have been attending Springs Church since 2023. He and Deb have been married for 31 years and have two children, ages 17 and 19. 

The focus of this men's community group is to encourage each other in love and good works, and to practically apply what it means to love God with all of our heart, mind, soul, and strength - and love our neighbor as ourself.  We will make prayer, fasting, scripture study/memorization, and sharing our faith a regular part of our life.  The goal is to live life together, in the light, and to grow in maturity, and godliness.

items.name: Friday Prayer | Men's Group
items.desc: A free-form group style of worship and prayer. They meet every Friday morning for a time of prayer, praise, intercession and encouragement. All men are welcome.

items.name: Men of the Ascent | Activity Group
items.desc: Hiking & Backpacking Colorado 14er's Adventure and Brotherhood with a clear purpose. Men of the Ascent is a Christ-centered group helping men pursue their peak purpose; living God's will through faithful love, obedience, character, and stewardship in his home, at work and in the world. From now through early October weather permitting: • One Ascent per month • Weekly online devotionals and trip planning • Co-ed and family hikes once per month Come explore the Rocky Mountains, build real friendships, strengthen your walk with Christ, and carry purpose beyond the summit into everyday leadership.

items.name: Men's Mentorship | Fall 2026
items.desc:
Do you feel like you are running full speed but not moving forward? We are excited to invite you to a 6-week men's mentorship journey designed to help you intentionally evaluate key areas of your walk with the Lord. Over these six weeks, you will take an honest look at our relationship with God, your heart, others, the world, and your calling. This will be a time of accountability, encouragement, and practical application as we challenge one another to take the next steps in our faith. These six weeks are not the finish line, but the first steps toward advancing in your walk with the Lord and becoming the man God has called you to be.
If you are interested, sign-up or email Derrik DeWitt.

items.name: Monday Night "Meating" | Men's Activity Group
items.desc: Get ready for the ultimate kickoff. We are bringing together the perfect game-day trifecta: Food, Football, & Fellowship. Whether you are here for the hard-hitting plays, the slow-smoked meats, or just some great company, there is a spot on the roster for you. Bring your appetite, bring a friend, and let's talk football!

items.name: Sexual Integrity | Men's Group
items.desc:
This is a faith driven brotherhood for men who want to live with sexual integrity and refuse to let secrecy, pornography, and lust define their lives. Right now, in a culture that normalizes sexual compromise, Springs Church men are choosing to take a stand and reclaim discipline, character, and leadership.

Through structured groups led with biblical truth and clinical insight from Fire Forged Coaching founder Chase Cocking, LPCC, men meet together in a confidential setting to confront destructive patterns and pursue real change. As Proverbs 27:17 says, "Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another," and this brotherhood exists so men can challenge, strengthen, and sharpen one another in the pursuit of integrity. These groups provide a place where men can speak honestly, be challenged by other men, and develop the tools needed to rebuild integrity in their thoughts, relationships, and behavior. We do this because your mind, your current or future marriage, and your legacy are worth fighting for and no man should have to fight this battle alone.

items.name: Grot | Women's Home Group
items.desc: Ladies, if you live out east, you are warmly invited to join us once a month for a casual Saturday morning brunch. This is an intentional space dedicated to stepping away from the busyness of life to build lasting friendships, share a delicious meal, and encourage one another. Together, we will spend time lifting each other up in prayer and strengthening our daily walk with God. No matter what season of life you are navigating, there is a seat at the table waiting for you. Come as you are, bring your favorite breakfast dish to share, and let's grow closer to Christ and to one another.

items.name: Housley | Women's Home Group
items.desc:
This ongoing Home Group is for women of any spiritual background and experience, single or married, who would like to grow in their relationship with God and others.
I have known Jesus as my Lord for over 50 years. I love bringing women together to fellowship around God's Word, with a cup of tea and real-life conversation. I would be happy for you to join us.
We have three goals: 1) to grow in our understanding of the Bible, 2) to make lasting friendships and, 3) to have lots of fun together.

items.name: Military Wives | Women's Group
items.desc: Military life brings unique joys and challenges, and our hope is to create a place where you can build meaningful friendships with other Christian women at Springs Church who understand this season of life and share your values.

items.name: Moms Group
items.desc: During the school year, moms with young children are invited to a fellowship designed to spiritually refresh and provide friendship in this busy season of life. Join us the first Tuesday of every month at 10AM in the Kids Auditorium. Hosted by Beth Petillo with special guest speakers every month. Childcare available by RSVP.

items.name: Revelation Wellness | Women's Activity Group
items.desc: Ladies, have you ever felt like your body is something you need to fix, hide, or constantly work on? Our culture tells us our bodies are too much, not enough, too old, too young… just never quite right. But God speaks a better word. Join Laura Schwarz, a certified Revelation Wellness Instructor and Health Coach, for the How to Love God & Your Body Meet Up for a life-giving time of worship, biblical teaching, and movement that brings joy instead of judgment. Together we'll learn what it means to love God and our bodies in a way that brings freedom and hope.

items.name: Board Game Club | Young Adults Group
items.desc: Board Game Club is for you gamers! Each meeting we will play a different game, enjoying time together and good ole' competition. Board Game Club will be hosted by young adults from Springs YA.

items.name: Book Club | Young Adults Group
items.desc: Join us the 1st & 3rd Thursdays as we read through "The Gospel Comes With A House Key" by Rosaria Butterfield.

items.name: Coffee Club | Young Adults Group
items.desc: Coffee Club is a time to meet other young adults who enjoy coffee, supporting local businesses, and sharing our stories.

items.name: Hiking Club | Young Adults Group
items.desc: Hiking Club gives us the opportunity to enjoy Colorado together as a community. Each meeting, typically Saturday mornings, we will meet at a different hiking trail and spend time enjoying God's beauty.

items.name: Supper Club | Young Adults Group
items.desc: Supper Club is a time to eat together, share stories, and slow down. We will meet at different homes each meeting, hosted by Young Adults within our community!
